# offering-service

> Aggregate root; DRAFT → PUBLISHING → PUBLISHED state machine; Camunda saga orchestrator.

## Docs

- [Overview](wiki/overview.md): State machine, Camunda integration, pre-flight validation, endpoints, saga tests.

## Source

- Entrypoint: `services/offering-service/src/main.py`
- Domain: `services/offering-service/src/domain/models.py`
- BPMN: `services/offering-service/bpmn/offering-publication-saga.bpmn`
- Saga worker: `services/offering-service/src/saga_worker.py`
- Tests: `services/offering-service/tests/`
